{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:JabbaHookah-ROTJ.png|250px|thumb|Jabba smoking his hookah pipe]]
A '''hookah pipe''' was a large '''water pipe''' device used for smoking various substances, such as [[Marcan herb/Legends|Marcan herbs]] or other intoxicants. The pipes were designed to be quite ornate and used the same basic components; the bowl, [[Water/Legends|water]] jar, and a length of hose with a mouthpiece on the end.

==Owners==
===Hutts===
[[File:Teemo the Hutt.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Teemo]] the Hutt uses a Hookah pipe]]
The hookah pipe was very popular with the Hutts, particularly those who were the head of major and powerful criminal empires.

[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], the infamous kingpin of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], almost always had a hookah with a removable lid by his side.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref> On the top portion was a gas substance which he would inhale and exhale. It had a long tube on the very top that he would hold to smoke the substance. This was one of his many trademarks.

On the bottom portion of Jabba's pipe was a feeding bowl.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" /> In it were live creatures that Jabba would occasionally eat. He would have the pipe removed for special occasions, such as a dance number from one of the bands he employed, going on a trip to make deals, or when he would go to [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]]. Otherwise, he would be smoking the concoction constantly.

Other Hutts, such as [[Aruk Besadii Aora]], [[Bogga]], [[Boonda/Legends|Boonda]], [[Borvo]], [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], [[Orko]], [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]], and [[Durga Besadii Tai]], smoked a hookah pipe on occasion.

===Others===
[[Thon]] smoked from a hookah pipe in his house on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]].<ref name="Tales of the Jedi 4: The Saga of Nomi Sunrider, Part 2">[[Tales of the Jedi 4|''Tales of the Jedi'' 4]]</ref>

[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] also kept a water pipe of free-form tarnished chrome in his [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|home]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Star Wars: A New Hope novelization">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hark'r]], the [[Noehon]] [[Supply Master/Legends|supply master]] for [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], owned a water pipe.<ref name="CC">''[[Classic Campaigns]]''</ref>
